training: One-factor comparison against style-trial-v1: identical prepared data, initialization, four epochs, seed, optimizer, selection and distillation; change supervised mixture from 0.75 ETL + 0.25 synthetic to 0.50 ETL + 0.50 synthetic. This tests whether reference-style adaptation is underweighted. Keep all previous gates, including 6/6 observed loops and ETL regression limits. No model deployment without all gates and confirmation.
selection: Unchanged equal-source known-script ETL validation top1, mean all-92 loss tie, earliest epoch. Retain all epochs. Shape validation and observed failures do not select epochs.
promotion: All original trial-v1 promotion gates and independent-seed confirmation remain required against the archived pre-finetune baseline. Additionally require no more than 0.25pp regression in any original/clean ETL validation group relative to current deployed residual, 100 percent on original 2208 positive controls, no reduction on the 1104 clipped controls, and improvement on the six observed small-loop controls. No additional >=0.99 non-kana cases. Shape transform validation is diagnostic only and cannot waive a gate. Native/Wasm parity and <10MB remain required. No automatic deployment. All six observed small-loop controls must now be correct, as a development check. Report adapted-source gains separately from KanjiVG and ETL. No corruption is a supervised positive.
limitation: Previously inspected AnimCJK hiragana is now adapted training-source data, including the style of the observed る failures. Its canonical and transformed controls are development regression checks, not independent source accuracy. Existing promotion gates remain unchanged and cannot establish modern beginner handwriting accuracy.
